g.text: The bound clears the standard. Nothing is lost by the simpler model, and a vocabulary that could not say this would be
0 — a non-detection permits any value down to zero
the answer is the constant, not the measurement
Art. 3(3b): a below-quantification result whose limit exceeds the standard shall not be considered. The two-valued
answer flips with the substitution constant, and the record does not say which was used.
Permethrin — CENSO: censo:MethodInsufficient (the verdict IS the convention)
0 — a non-detection permits any value down to zero
Art. 4(1) permits 50 % expanded uncertainty at the level of the standard, so this interval straddles it. A method
meeting only the legal minimum cannot decide either way.
Clarithromycin — CENSO: censo:PossibleExceedance (inside the law's own uncertainty)
the answer is the constant, not the measurement
Annex I footnote 9 makes the cadmium standard vary with water hardness. WISE-6 reports no hardness on the row, so the
number in the table and the number in the record are not measurements of the same quantity.
Cadmium and its compounds — CENSO: censo:PreconditionUnmet (the standard is not defined on what was measured)
0 — a non-detection permits any value down to zero
